Question 5
?

Given the ellipsoid (x−1)2+(y−1)2+(z−1)23=1, find the domain of z=z(x,y).

a
{(x,y):x2+y2<1}
b
{(x,y):(x−1)2+(y−1)2≤1}
c
{(x,y):(x−1)2+(y−1)23≤1}
d
{(x,y):(x−1)2+y2>1}
e
{(x,y):(x−1)2+(y−1)2≤13}
Submit
